editorial.body: Korea is on course to have the world’s oldest population by 2060, overtaking Japan. The projection is more than a demographic curiosity. It is a wa...
editorial.pullQuote: Korea is on course to have the world's oldest population by 2060, overtaking Japan.
summary: Korea will have the world's oldest population by 2060, surpassing Japan.
Extreme aging poses serious economic and social challenges ahead.
The demographic shift demands urgent policy preparation and reform.
editorial.stance: Urgent action needed to address Korea's accelerating demographic crisis.
summaryTr: 한국은 2060년까지 일본을 제치고 세계에서 가장 고령화된 인구를 가지게 될 것이다.
극심한 고령화는 향후 심각한 경제사회적 도전을 야기할 것으로 보인다.
이러한 인구 구조 변화는 시급한 정책 준비와 개혁을 요구하고 있다.
editorial.bodyTr: 한국이 2060년까지 일본을 제치고 세계에서 가장 고령화된 인구를 갖게 될 길로 나아가고 있다. 이 전망은 단순한 인구통계학적 호기심 이상의 의미를 지닌다.

leanScore.label: Center
leanScore.rationale: The editorial identifies a demographic crisis requiring urgent policy action but avoids advocating specific progressive or conservative solutions—framing aging as a shared national challenge rather than blaming either market failures or welfare dependency.

editorial.titleTr: [Editorial] Major shareholder pockets 6.3 billion, broker takes 600 million, only investors left in tears—is this really serving the public interest?
summaryTr: Justice Minister nominee suspected of requesting new drug clinical trial approval from food and drug agency
Major shareholder pocketed 6.3 billion won while broker took 600 million, leaving 30,000 investors as victims
Claims to be serving public interest but inappropriately intervened despite lack of job-related connection
editorial.bodyTr: Justice Minister nominee Kim Seung-won faces allegations that he solicited the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety's approval for clinical trials of a new drug. Through this alleged intervention, major shareholders and brokers reaped substantial profits, while approximately 30,000 retail investors suffered losses as clinical trials proceeded with side effects concealed. The nominee's camp claims it was a matter of public interest, but criticism continues that this constituted inappropriate interference unrelated to his official duties.

editorials.titleTr: Opinion: Non-Resident Deputy PM and Debt-Fueled Land Minister Miss Reality with Housing Policy
summaryTr: The real estate holdings history of the candidate for deputy prime minister and minister of land, infrastructure and transport conflicts with regulatory policies.
Calls are growing for the government to address unrealistic real estate regulations.
There is an urgent need to establish policies to restore the housing ladder for younger generations.
editorials.bodyTr: Controversy has emerged over the real estate holdings history of Lee Hyung-il, the nominee for deputy prime minister for the economy, and Hong Ji-seon, the nominee for minister of land, infrastructure and transport, arguing that their records conflict with the government's existing regulatory policies. In response, calls are growing for the upcoming confirmation hearings to improve unrealistic real estate regulations and establish policy alternatives to restore the housing ladder for younger generations.

editorial.body: 입력 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자가 코로나19 치료제 임상시험 승인 청탁 의혹에 대해 “민원 전달 과정에서 더욱 신중하게 해야 했다”면서도 “부정한 청탁을 한 적이 없다”고 말했다. 자신이 식약처장에게 전화를 걸고 문자를 보낸 사실을 “민원 전달”이라고 표현하며 문제될 일이 아니라는 뜻을 밝힌 것으로 들린다. 지금 공개된 녹취로 드러난 김 후보자의 청탁 전후 언행을 놓고 공직자로서의 적격 여부를 문제 삼으며 여론이 들끓고 있는 것과는 천양지차의 안일한 인식이다. 김 후보자는 “승인되는 순간 수천억원을 벌 수 있는 거”라고 말했다. “승원 오빠가 식약처장에게다 얘기하고 오늘 또 ‘보건복지부에 푸시해 줄까’라고 그랬다”는 청탁 브로커 양씨의 녹취도 나왔다. 이쯤 되면 일의 앞뒤가 짐작되고도 남는데도, 김 후보자가 ‘공익 민원’이라고까지 강변하고 있으니 국민의 상식과 법 감정에 정면으로 반한다. 김 후보자는 자신의 결백을 주장하면서 “식약처의 심사가 공정하게 이뤄지지 않은 것도 아니다”는 점을 들었는데 이 역시 인식의 왜곡이다. 국민이 문제 삼는 것은 적절치 못한 청탁성 민원 그 자체에 있는 것이지, 민원의 결과를 묻고 있는 것이 아니다. 위법은 행위의 순간에 성립되는 것이지 성공 여부에 따라 가려지는 게 아님은 법조인 출신인 김 후보자가 누구보다도 잘 알 터이다. 더구나 김 의원의 청탁이 얼마나 작용했는지는 지금 알 수 없지만, 해당 업체는 실제로 임상시험 승인을 받았다. 법무부 장관은 법 질서를 확립해야 하는 자리다. 그런 만큼 잣대의 공정성이 무엇보다 중요하다. 그런데 정작 장관 후보자가 공과 사를 구분하지 못하고 사적 이권을 위해 지위를 이용한 정황이 드러나고 있다. 김 후보자에게 임상시험 승인을 청탁한 브로커는 해당 기업 대표로부터 거액을 투자받은 사실까지 확인됐다. 임상시험 승인 전후로 미공개 정보를 이용한 주식 거래 등 다양한 형태의 불법 행위가 이뤄져 일반투자자들의 피해도 발생했다. 이런 일과 관련해 부정 청탁 의혹이 제기되는 후보자에게, 더구나 자신이 한 일에 대한 사과는커녕 대수롭지 않다는 투로 말하는 사람에게 법치주의의 수호라는 중책을 맡길 수 있겠는가.

editorial.titleTr: Ex-Justice Minister Nominee Claims Improper Favor Request Was Public Interest Petition
summaryTr: Justice Minister nominee Kim Seung-won claims clinical trial approval request was 'public interest petition'
Recorded conversation reveals mention of hundreds of billions in profits, involvement of bribery brokers and other damaging circumstances
Legal expert's inability to distinguish public from private affairs and abuse of position raises questions about qualifications to uphold rule of law
editorial.bodyTr:
Justice Minister nominee Kim Seung-won said he should have been "more cautious in the process of conveying civil complaints" regarding allegations of soliciting approval for a COVID-19 treatment drug clinical trial, but claimed he "never made improper solicitations." By describing his phone calls and text messages to the head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety as a "civil complaint delivery," he appears to be suggesting there is nothing problematic about his actions. This complacent perception stands in stark contrast to the current public outcry questioning his qualifications as a public official based on his words and actions before and after the alleged solicitation, as revealed in the recently released recordings.

Kim said, "The moment it gets approved, you can make hundreds of billions of won." A recording also emerged of broker Yang, who allegedly brokered the solicitation, saying, "Seung-won oppa talked to the head of the Food and Drug Safety Ministry, and today he said, 'Should I push this to the Ministry of Health and Welfare too?'" Given this sequence of events, one can well infer what happened. Yet Kim continues to insist this was a "public interest civil complaint," directly contradicting the common sense and legal sensibilities of the public. Kim argued his innocence by stating that "the Food and Drug Safety Ministry's review was conducted fairly," but this too reflects a distorted understanding. What the public takes issue with is the inappropriate nature of the solicitation-like complaint itself, not the outcome of the complaint. As someone with a legal background, Kim should know better than anyone that wrongdoing is established at the moment of the act, not determined by whether it succeeds or fails. Moreover, while we cannot yet determine how much influence Kim's solicitation had, the company in question did actually receive approval for the clinical trial. The Minister of Justice is tasked with establishing the rule of law, making impartiality of standards paramount. Yet the nominee himself is showing signs of failing to distinguish between public and private interests and abusing his position for personal gain. The broker who solicited Kim for clinical trial approval was confirmed to have received substantial investments from the company's representative. Various forms of illegal activity—including stock trading based on non-public information before and after the clinical trial approval—took place, causing losses to ordinary investors. Can we entrust the protection of the rule of law to a nominee facing allegations of improper solicitation in connection with such activities, especially one who shows no remorse for his actions and dismisses them as trivial?

editorial.title: Unanswered questions
editorial.body: Allegations of improper solicitation raise doubts about Kim's fitness to serve as justice minister Suspicions surrounding Justice Minister nominee Kim Seung-won continue to mount after it was revealed following his nomination that he had previously been investigated by prosecutors. In October 2021, Kim, then a first-term Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker, was investigated for allegedly requesting the then head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety to approve clinical trials for a COVID-19 drug developed by Genencell, at the request of a female broker surnamed Yang, who was also an acquaintance of his. In December 2024, prosecutors decided not to indict him. Yang is on trial on charges of promising to give Kim a bribe. According to her indictment, as reported by the media, the founder and largest shareholder of Genencell, identified as Kang, asked Yang to have the clinical trial approved quickly. Yang then asked Kim to make the request to the head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety. Yang referred to Kim as “oppa (older brother)” among other terms of familiarity. The clinical trial was approved just two weeks after Kim asked Kim Kang-lip, then head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, to expedite the process. Kim Seung-won maintains that there was no wrongdoing, noting that the case underwent an extensive investigation for about three years under former President Yoon Suk Yeol, a former member of the current opposition People Power Party. He says that he merely conveyed a public-interest grievance. According to Yang’s indictment, however, Kim told her that the maximum political contribution was 5 million won, saying, in effect, “If things work out, that’s all you need to do.” When she told Kim that Kang would make a political donation, Kim gave her his bank account number and even thanked her. However, Kim had already reached his annual limit for political donations, and the transfer Yang mentioned was never made. Also shocking is a selfie taken by Yang at a Korean restaurant in Seoul in February 2022, with Kim, the Genencell founder, and a judge who handled the review of an arrest warrant against Kang. Kim had worked with the judge when he was a judge himself. When the judge took charge of Kang’s case, the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office petitioned the Supreme Court to recuse the judge over concerns of conflict of interest, but the petition was rejected. The judge denied an arrest warrant for Kang. Later, a different judge issued an arrest warrant for him. More serious, however, was the fact that the stock price of Sejong Medical, which became Genencell’s largest shareholder after Kang sold his shares before the clinical trial was approved, soared on the positive news of the approval before plunging after it became known that negative results from animal trials had been concealed. Investors suffered heavy losses. Phone calls and text messages exchanged between Yang and Kim, made public by independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, suggest that Kim may have been aware, before making the request to the head of the ministry, that the clinical trial approval could benefit Genencell's share price, and that he could also benefit from it. A reinvestigation is needed to determine whether Kim’s alleged improper solicitation was linked to stock price manipulation. Prosecutors reportedly initially planned to indict Kim and seek an eight-month prison sentence, so it is also necessary to determine how he ended up receiving a suspension of indictment. A lawmaker conveyed an acquaintance’s request to the head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, who effectively instructed his staff to accommodate the request. It was Yang who prompted Kim to “convey” what he called a “petition” to the head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety. No one expects that he would have done the same if the petitioner had been someone other than Yang. The public now questions whether Kim is qualified to hold any public office, let alone serve as justice minister. editorial.bodyTr: 김승원 법무부장관 후보자에 대한 부당 청탁 의혹이 그의 적격성에 의문을 제기하다 김승원 법무부장관 후보자를 둘러싼 의혹이 계속 커지고 있다. 그의 지명 이후 검찰의 이전 수사를 받은 사실이 드러났기 때문이다. 2021년 10월 당시 민주당 1선 의원이던 김씨는 지인인 양모 브로커의 요청으로 지엔셀이 개발한 코로나19 치료제의 임상시험 승인을 당시 식품의약품안전처 처장에게 요청한 혐의로 수사를 받았다. 2024년 12월 검찰은 그를 기소하지 않기로 결정했다. 양씨는 김씨에게 뇌물을 주겠다고 약속한 혐의로 재판 중이다. 언론 보도에 따른 양씨의 공소장에 따르면 지엔셀의 창업자이자 최대 주주인 강모씨가 양씨에게 임상시험 승인을 빨리 받아달라고 요청했다. 양씨는 이어 김씨에게 식품의약품안전처 처장에게 요청해달라고 부탁했다. 양씨는 김씨를 '오빠' 등 친근한 표현으로 불렀다. 김씨가 당시 식품의약품안전처 처장 김강립씨에게 절차 신속화를 요청한 지 불과 2주 후 임상시험이 승인됐다. 김승원 의원은 잘못된 행위가 없다고 주장하며 현 야당인 국민의힘 출신의 윤석열 전 대통령 재임 시절 약 3년에 걸쳐 광범위한 수사가 이루어졌다고 지적했다. 그는 단지 공익민원을 전달했을 뿐이라고 말한다. 하지만 양씨의 공소장에 따르면 김씨는 정치 후원금 상한이 500만원이라며 "일이 잘 되면 그 정도만 하면 된다"는 취지의 말을 했다. 양씨가 강씨가 정치후원금을 하겠다고 말했을 때 김씨는 자신의 계좌번호를 알려주고 감사까지 표했다. 다만 김씨는 이미 연간 정치후원금 한도에 도달한 상태였고 양씨가 말한 송금은 이루어지지 않았다. 더욱 충격적인 것은 2022년 2월 서울의 한 한식당에서 양씨가 찍은 셀카 사진이다. 사진에는 김씨, 지엔셀 창업자, 그리고 강씨의 구속영장 심사를 담당한 판사가 함께 찍혀 있다. 김씨는 판사로 재직할 때 그 판사와 함께 일한 적이 있다. 판사가 강씨의 사건을 맡게 되자 대검찰청은 이해충돌 우려를 이유로 판사 기피 신청을 대법원에 했지만 기각됐다. 판사는 강씨에 대한 구속영장을 기각했다. 나중에 다른 판사가 구속영장을 발부했다. 하지만 더욱 심각한 것은 강씨가 임상시험 승인 전에 지분을 매각한 후 지엔셀의 최대 주주가 된 세종의료의 주가 움직임이다. 승인 소식에 주가가 폭등했다가 동물실험에서 부정적 결과가 은폐된 사실이 알려지면서 폭락했다. 투자자들은 막대한 손실을 입었다. 한동훈 무소속 의원이 공개한 양씨와 김씨 간의 통화 기록과 문자 메시지는 김씨가 식품의약품안전처 처장에게 요청하기 전에 이미 임상시험 승인이 지엔셀의 주가를 올릴 수 있고 자신도 이로부터 이득을 볼 수 있다는 사실을 알고 있었을 가능성을 시사한다. 김씨의 부당 청탁이 주가조작과 연결되어 있는지 여부를 판단하기 위해서는 재수사가 필요하다. 검찰이 당초 김씨를 기소해 징역 8개월을 구형할 계획이었던 것으로 알려진 만큼 어떻게 해서 기소유예 처분을 받게 되었는지도 규명해야 한다. 의원이 지인의 요청을 식품의약품안전처 처장에게 전달했고 처장은 실질적으로 부하 직원에게 해당 요청에 응하도록 지시했다. 김씨가 식품의약품안전처 처장에게 '청원'이라고 부르는 것을 '전달'하도록 한 것은 양씨였다. 청탁자가 양씨가 아닌 다른 사람이었다면 그가 같은 행동을 했을 리 없다고 누구나 생각한다. 이제 국민은 김씨가 공직에 적합한지, 더욱이 법무부장관직을 맡기에 적절한지에 대해 의문을 제기하고 있다.

editorials.title: Unanswered questions
editorials.body: Allegations of improper solicitation raise doubts about Kim's fitness to serve as justice minister Suspicions surrounding Justice Minister nominee Kim Seung-won continue to mount after it was revealed following his nomination that he had previously been investigated by prosecutors. In October 2021, Kim, then a first-term Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker, was investigated for allegedly requesting the then head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety to approve clinical trials for a COVID-19 drug developed by Genencell, at the request of a female broker surnamed Yang, who was also an acquaintance of his. In December 2024, prosecutors decided not to indict him. Yang is on trial on charges of promising to give Kim a bribe. According to her indictment, as reported by the media, the founder and largest shareholder of Genencell, identified as Kang, asked Yang to have the clinical trial approved quickly. Yang then asked Kim to make the request to the head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety. Yang referred to Kim as “oppa (older brother)” among other terms of familiarity. The clinical trial was approved just two weeks after Kim asked Kim Kang-lip, then head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, to expedite the process. Kim Seung-won maintains that there was no wrongdoing, noting that the case underwent an extensive investigation for about three years under former President Yoon Suk Yeol, a former member of the current opposition People Power Party. He says that he merely conveyed a public-interest grievance. According to Yang’s indictment, however, Kim told her that the maximum political contribution was 5 million won, saying, in effect, “If things work out, that’s all you need to do.” When she told Kim that Kang would make a political donation, Kim gave her his bank account number and even thanked her. However, Kim had already reached his annual limit for political donations, and the transfer Yang mentioned was never made. Also shocking is a selfie taken by Yang at a Korean restaurant in Seoul in February 2022, with Kim, the Genencell founder, and a judge who handled the review of an arrest warrant against Kang. Kim had worked with the judge when he was a judge himself. When the judge took charge of Kang’s case, the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office petitioned the Supreme Court to recuse the judge over concerns of conflict of interest, but the petition was rejected. The judge denied an arrest warrant for Kang. Later, a different judge issued an arrest warrant for him. More serious, however, was the fact that the stock price of Sejong Medical, which became Genencell’s largest shareholder after Kang sold his shares before the clinical trial was approved, soared on the positive news of the approval before plunging after it became known that negative results from animal trials had been concealed. Investors suffered heavy losses. Phone calls and text messages exchanged between Yang and Kim, made public by independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, suggest that Kim may have been aware, before making the request to the head of the ministry, that the clinical trial approval could benefit Genencell's share price, and that he could also benefit from it. A reinvestigation is needed to determine whether Kim’s alleged improper solicitation was linked to stock price manipulation. Prosecutors reportedly initially planned to indict Kim and seek an eight-month prison sentence, so it is also necessary to determine how he ended up receiving a suspension of indictment. A lawmaker conveyed an acquaintance’s request to the head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, who effectively instructed his staff to accommodate the request. It was Yang who prompted Kim to “convey” what he called a “petition” to the head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety. No one expects that he would have done the same if the petitioner had been someone other than Yang. The public now questions whether Kim is qualified to hold any public office, let alone serve as justice minister. editorial.titleTr: AI's 'Promethean Moment' Sparks Debate on Coexistence Intelligence at Knowledge Forum
summaryTr: The rapid evolution of AI marks another inflection point in human civilization.
Like Prometheus's fire, AI carries the dual nature of progress and catastrophe.
A new agenda of coexistence intelligence is being presented.
editorial.bodyTr: Humanity's civilizational clock is passing through another major inflection point. 기존 정책에서 벗어나 새로운 방향 전환이 필요한 시점이다.
editorials.stance: 정부는 국민의 경제 정책 불만을 직시하고 시장 중심의 혁신적 정책 전환으로 경제 활성화에 나서야 한다.
editorials.titleTr: Op-Ed: 61% Say Economy Is Mismanaged... Time to Shift Policy Focus to Market Vitality
summaryTr: 61% of the public evaluates the government's economic policies as misguided.
The government must squarely face the urgent need to restore market vitality.
It is time to break from existing policies and shift toward a new direction.

leanScore.label: Lean conservative
leanScore.rationale: 시장 중심의 혁신적 정책 전환을 강조하며 기존 정책(암묵적으로 규제/복지 정책)의 전환을 주장하는 것은 전형적인 보수진영의 규제 완화/시장경제 옹호 프레이밍
